parameters.name: block number
parameters.description: The block number identified by the slot

result.description: The custom object with the following field

result.commitment.description: The commitment values for the block. It could be either:

result.commitment.null.description: Null if the block is unknown

result.commitment.array.description: An array of u64 integers logging the amount of cluster stake in lamports that has voted on the block at each depth from 0 to MAX_LOCKOUT_HISTORY + 1

result.totalStake.description: The total number of lamports being used by validators to participate in the block production and voting process
